name: WF-235 — Seller Offer Package → Offer Dispatch, Delivery Receipt & Negotiation State

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const offer=Number(d.offer_price??NaN),mao=Number(d.maximum_offer??d.dynamic_mao??NaN),channel=String(d.channel??"").toLowerCase(),status=String(d.offer_package_status??d.state??"").toLowerCase();const validChannel=["sms","email"].includes(channel);const validOffer=Number.isFinite(offer)&&Number.isFinite(mao)&&offer<=mao;let state="blocked",route="WF-126",reason="Offer dispatch is not ready.";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){reason="Missing seller/deal/property identity.";}else if(status!=="offer_package_ready"){reason="Seller offer package is not confirmed ready.";route="WF-234";}else if(!validChannel){reason="Unsupported or missing communication channel.";route="WF-234";}else if(!validOffer){reason="Offer exceeds or cannot be validated against the protected MAO ceiling.";route="WF-234";}else{const dispatch_id=['wf235',deal_id,Date.now()].join(':');const idempotency_key=['offer_dispatch',deal_id,offer,channel].join(':');state="dispatch_ready";route="WF-236";reason="Offer dispatch state is prepared and awaiting provider delivery receipt.";return[{json:{workflow:"WF-235",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,offer_price:offer,maximum_offer:mao,channel,dispatch_id,idempotency_key,dispatch:{status:"pending_provider",delivery_receipt_required:true,provider_runtime_required:true},state,route,reason,requires_human_review:true}}];}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-235",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,offer_price:offer,maximum_offer:mao,channel,state,route,reason,requires_human_review:true}}];
